title: What The Accordion Knows — EN/IT/ES (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal accordion English Italian Spanish language learning trilingual world instruments
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The accordion enters the room with everything it has
Both hands doing different things at once
Which is the Italian way of handling Tuesday

[Verse 2 — Italiano]
Tiri i mantici per portare dentro la nota [You pull the bellows to bring the note in]
Spingi per rimandarlo indietro [You push to send it back]
La fisarmonica respira come una persona [The accordion breathes like a person]
Che ha deciso che respirare dovrebbe essere drammatico [Who has decided breathing should be dramatic]

[Chorus — English]
What the accordion knows
Every language sounds better in it
The accordion played at the wedding, played at the wake
The accordion knows — the accordion was awake

[Bridge — Español]
Chas escuchó un acordeón en Roma una vez [Chas heard an accordion in Rome once]
A través de una ventana abierta, tres pisos arriba [Through an open window, three floors up]
Dijo — ese es el único instrumento [He said — that's the only instrument]
Que suena como si estuviera discutiendo consigo mismo [That sounds like it's arguing with itself]
Y ganando [And winning]

[Verse 3 — English]
You can't sing Italian without the accordion understanding
Just as you can't play the accordion without some Italian happening

[Outro — EN/IT/ES]
What the accordion knows
Quello che sa la fisarmonica [What the accordion knows]
Lo que sabe el acordeón [What the accordion knows]
That's my boy
